- When sentiment is strongly bullish (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next period.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >80), model often overshoots and fails to correct; cap forecast at +5% above peak or use 3-period moving average for smoothing.
- If sentiment turns bearish (≤ -0.5) within 5 days, model overreacts; apply downward bias of 2–4% for 3–5 days ahead.
- Model consistently overpredicts early in 30-day horizon; apply 1–2% downward adjustment for first 7 days.
- When sentiment is mixed (0.0–0.67), model exhibits mean-reversion bias; align forecast with 14-day rolling average of true values.
- If sentiment history shows repeated reversal (e.g., +0.67 → -0.5 → +0.67), model fails to anticipate; apply 1–3% lagged correction based on prior 7-day true value.
